root_cause_label: Terminal session stuck at step 9 burned remaining step budget through ineffective recovery, preventing any wait for Windows XP installation completion
one_sentence_failure_summary: A stuck terminal session from step 9 consumed nine steps with fruitless Ctrl-C/Ctrl-Z/Ctrl-D and empty-command attempts, leaving no budget to wait for the Windows XP unattended installation to finish, so the agent claimed completion while the OS was still installing.
t_err_evidence: Step 9 is the first execution after websockify/QEMU launch where the terminal returns exit_code=-1 with no output, indicating the session is stuck; the agent fails to diagnose or recover and instead repeats the same command and issues terminal control keystrokes (Ctrl-C, Ctrl-Z, Ctrl-D) in steps 10-17, consuming 9 of the remaining steps.
t_commit_evidence: At step 18 the agent switches to IPython, launches QEMU via subprocess.run (blocking call), confirms ports 5901/6080/80 listening, and then at step 19 marks all infrastructure tasks as 'done' with installation 'in_progress'. With only 4 steps remaining and no polling loop or wait mechanism introduced, the failure to wait for installation completion is now locked in given the agent's actual behavior.
t_surface_evidence: Step 22 is the finish() call claiming full completion ('Everything required is configured, the VM is running... The system will reach the Windows XP login screen automatically') while the installation was still in its early minutes, providing no evidence of a completed install, renamed administrator, or reachable login screen.
trigger_explanation: From step 9 onward the terminal session became stuck (exit_code=-1, working_dir=None). The correct response would have been to open a new terminal session or use the IPython fallback immediately. Instead the agent issued the same websockify command again (step 10), then an empty command (step 11), Ctrl-C (step 12), the websockify command again (step 13), another empty command (step 14), Ctrl-Z (step 15), Ctrl-D (step 16), and another Ctrl-C (step 17) before finally switching to IPython at step 18. These nine wasted steps eliminated any possibility of waiting for the 20-30 minute Windows XP installation within the 22-step budget.
forewarning_evidence: Step 9 shows exit_code=-1 and working_dir=None with no output, a clear signal the terminal session is broken. Steps 10 and 13 repeat the identical websockify command with the same exit_code=-1 result. Steps 11 and 14 produce empty commands. The pattern of all-failure exit codes constitutes strong forewarning before t_commit at step 18.
